title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio and Percentage of Lot Coverage
previewText:
R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

In all districts, as indicated, for any zoning lot, the maximum floor area ratio and maximum percent of lot coverage for a community facility use shall not exceed the floor area ratio and lot coverage set forth in the table in this Section.

Any given lot area shall be counted only once in determining the floor area ratio.

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Added R11 and R12 applicability; updated FAR tables
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to expand opportunities for housing within all zoning districts, and across all 59 of the City’s Community Districts
TEXT AMENDMENT TARGETING ZONING REGULATIONS TO PROVIDE MORE AFFORDABLE HOUSING AND SENIOR CARE FACILITIES
TEXT AMENDMENT TO CLARIFY AND PRESERVE THE INTENT OF THE ZONING REGULATIONS IN RELATION TO THE TERMS "DEVELOPMENT" AND "BUILDING" AS DEFINED IN THE ZONING RESOLUTION
TEXT CHANGE TO ESTABLISH A C6-3D ZONING DIST TO ALLOW HIGH- DENSITY RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL & COMMUNITY FACILITY USES
TEXT CHANGE TO ESTABLISH CITYWIDE DISTS R7D & C4-5D AS WELL AS A MIXED USE DIST M101/R7D
TEXT AMEND TO VARIOUS ZR SECTIONS FOR RESIDENTIAL, URBAN, ELEVATED & SUNKEN PLAZAS
MODIFIED TEXT FOR A NEW CITYWIDE R5D DISIGNATION
TEXT AMENDMENTS TO SIMPLIFY & IMPROVE REGULATIONS FOR NEW PLAZAS
TEXT CHANGES TO MODIFY THE ZONING CONTROLS GOVERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF QUALITY HOUSING BLDGS & THE DEVELOPMENT OF ALL BLDGS CITYWIDE & CREATE NEW C6-3X, R10X & C6-4X DISTS
TEXT CHANGE TO ELIMINATE RESIDENTAL PLAZA BONUS, ELIMINATE ALTERNATE FRONT SETBACK REGULATIONS, MANDATE A STREET WALL BASE FOR A TOWER ON WIDE STREETS FOR RESIDENTIAL BLDGS
MODIF TO THE CONTEXTUAL DISTRICT BULK CONTROLS
UPPER EAST SIDE MIDBLOCK FOLLOW-UP STUDY COMMUNITY FACILITIES. REVISION TO ZO TEXT TO ALLOW INSTITUTIONS W/IN THIS AREA MORE THAN 4 FAR
PROPOSED ZONING TEXT AMEND AS FOLLOW UP TO WEST SIDE STUDY
W/S DESIGNATIONS FOR HIGH-DENSITY AVES (R10A), COLUMBUS & AMSTERDAM AVES (R9AA) & MIDBLOCK (R8B), TO ENSURE COMPATIBLE DEVELOPMENT WHICH INCLUDES LINCOLN SQ DIST FAR CHANGE
TEX CHANGE TO ALLOW MODIFICATION OF R10 PROVISION
